question: Does a zero-shot daily time-series foundation model (TimesFM 3.0) over trailing 252-day market-adjusted daily returns predict 21-trading-day forward residual returns and short-squeeze tail risk on the liquid mandate universe?
mechanism: Charter 4 (Market Dynamics and Information Diffusion, spec 4.4) targets 20-trading-day residual returns. Daily return trajectories contain nonlinear continuation, volatility-compression, and post-shock diffusion patterns that monthly aggregates coarsen; quantile spread (q90 - q10) captures right-skewed short-squeeze jump risk.
falsification: Standalone monthly rank IC of tfm_daily_cum21 is not significantly positive (t < 1.96) across the 68 holding months
Quantile spread tfm_daily_q_spread fails to separate realized >30% short-squeeze tail events monotonically across quintiles
Adding tfm_daily to the C2/C6 FamilyIntegrator lowers net Information Ratio or worsens maximum drawdown after tiered transaction and borrow costs
Effect disappears under sector-neutral and beta-neutral portfolio construction at compounding $1B NAV capacity
